newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Mazatlan port cargo shipments rise.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Mazatlan port cargo shipments rise.

text.p: Activity at the Mexican port of Mazatlan has grown since the private sector began investing in the site, the Communications and Transport Ministry said in a statement Tuesday.
The port moved 194,000 tonnes of cargo in the month of January, while 18,000 tourists boarded tourist ships in the time period. Such shipments drew income of more than $1.51 million for the month.
For the month, 77 cargo ships and 114 container ships sailed, compared with a total 742 cargo ships and 14,210 container ships for 1996. The ministry did not provide further comparative data.
The port exports garbanzo beans, bales of cotton, tuna, and other products.
